It loads the cached SST for 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 plus the 2005 summer, builds per-cell 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day windows around 1992–2002 dates, and smooths them over 31 days. It then compares the 2005-06-01 to 2005-08-31 SST against those thresholds and joins runs, so the smoothing window around June–August doy 153–244 limits baseline input to doy 133–264 (May 12 to Sep 20) of each baseline year, for all sea cells."}
